title: Validate one explicit environment-bound target composition before application or provider wiring

requirements.invariant: The target has one explicit Supabase/PowerSync composition boundary and no Firestore application adapter, while the released Firebase app and backend remain unchanged before hard cutover.

Composition is an explicit typed set of currently available Ledger ports created only after environment validation; it contains infrastructure wiring, not accounting, duplicated listeners, vendor objects, a generic service locator or a runtime Firebase/Supabase switch.

One composition uses one exact environment and contract catalog; every advertised available capability has exactly one owning dependency, gated or unknown capabilities cannot be activated, and reference-only dependencies cannot enter application-runtime composition.

The separate target-composition module depends inward only on LedgerTargetCore and exposes Ledger/standard Swift types; its tests may use LedgerTargetTestSupport, while neither composition module imports a database, transport, Firebase, Supabase or PowerSync SDK.

Successful structural composition proves only exact environment, version, dependency and capability closure; it does not claim local durability, authorization, synchronization, provider fidelity, hosted readiness or production authority without each adapter's later contract evidence.

items: TargetCompositionUse distinguishes testReference from applicationRuntime and cannot be inferred from an environment name, adapter type or successful stream emission.

TargetCompositionDependencyKey is closed over the currently implemented contractCatalog, operationQueries and syncHealth ports; each key has one exact available-capability ownership set and accepts one typed EnvironmentBoundTargetDependency.

TargetDependencyDescriptor contains only a bounded stable implementation ID, dependency key, composition use, exact LedgerEnvironmentPersistenceBinding and sorted unique capability IDs; it cannot carry endpoints, secrets, provider payloads, database handles or transport errors.

TargetCompositionAssembler validates environment/catalog version compatibility, dependency key/binding/use agreement, exact available-capability closure and prohibited gated/deprecated/unknown ownership before returning ValidatedTargetComposition.

TargetCompositionReceipt is bounded canonical evidence over environment binding, contract versions, catalog capability state and dependency ownership; restore revalidates and cannot recreate or authorize runtime adapters.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This provider-free composition contract creates no Postgres schema, table, relationship, constraint, index, view or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative command handler, server transaction, lock, idempotency store or provider factory is implemented.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: No server rows or roles exist; structural environment/capability validation is not authorization and cannot substitute for RLS.

syncStreams.notApplicable: The composition contains the existing backend-neutral operation-query and sync-health ports but defines no PowerSync Stream, local schema, bucket, upload queue or visibility policy.

items: A validated composition receipt encodes to bounded canonical bytes and restores offline through the same environment/version/dependency/capability validators; reordered descriptors and capabilities normalize identically.

Missing/duplicate/wrong-key/cross-environment dependency bindings, reference/runtime mixing, catalog version mismatch, unknown/gated/deprecated or multiply-owned capabilities, unsafe implementation IDs, noncanonical bytes, digest tamper and oversized evidence fail atomically with stable safe codes.

Reference adapters can prove composition structure in target-local tests only; their successful operation/readiness streams never become evidence of a local database, PowerSync process, hosted service or synchronization.

storageMedia.notApplicable: No attachment port is currently advertised by the generated catalog and no byte, object, path, URL, upload or retention behavior exists.

appMcp.notApplicable: This slice defines and tests the reusable composition boundary only. It does not link the target app, construct an MCP transport, replace the current Firebase root or claim entry-point parity.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase export, source transform, target load or production-derived record is used; the composition receipt is structural evidence, not migration reconciliation.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable composition refusal codes are local contract values only; no telemetry sink, metric, alert or runbook action is introduced.

items: The composition and self-test modules are additive target-only Swift package targets; the composition target depends only on LedgerTargetCore and is absent from the Firebase application project.

The module is a structural factory boundary only: it cannot select Auth, instantiate Supabase/PowerSync, activate a product feature, prove adapter contracts, deploy, migrate, release or authorize cutover.
SWIFT-88C69E26FBA0 and all target app/MCP/provider/project/package integration surfaces remain target_mapped or in their owning slice until concrete wiring and contract evidence replace them.

verification.expected: A complete typed target-local reference composition validates one environment, matching catalog versions, exact dependency keys and one-owner available-capability closure and exposes the configured Ledger ports without a provider or service locator.

Canonical composition receipt evidence restores offline with identical environment/version/dependency/capability ownership, and equivalent input order produces identical bytes without reconstructing runtime adapters.

Missing, duplicate, wrong-key, cross-environment, incompatible-version, reference/runtime, unknown/gated/deprecated/multiply-owned capability, unsafe descriptor, noncanonical, tampered and oversized inputs fail with stable codes before any partial composition is returned.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, package graph/provider/source-contamination guards, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts while the Firebase project links no target composition code and no provider/runtime integration is claimed.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 technical-control foundation only. It stops before application/MCP wiring, provider factories or SDKs, local database/PowerSync behavior, Auth, Storage/media, product commands/queries, hosted staging, adapter/physical-offline claims, A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016, open product decisions, deployment, migration, production access or cutover authority.
